parameters.content:
## Knowledge base ingestion
One help-center article per request. The article is split by section, each chunk is embedded with OpenAI
and stored in PostgreSQL + pgvector. Re-sending an unchanged article costs nothing (content hash check);
a changed article replaces its old chunks in a single SQL statement, so search never sees half an update.

parameters.query:
SELECT encode(sha256(convert_to($2::text, 'UTF8')), 'hex') AS incoming_sha,
       (SELECT content_sha256 FROM kb_documents WHERE source = $1) AS stored_sha;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'unchanged', source: $('Validate & Chunk').first().json.doc.source, message: 'Content identical to the indexed version; nothing to do' }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'failed', source: $('Validate & Chunk').first().json.doc.source, errors: ['Embedding service unavailable, the previous version stays indexed. Please retry.'] }) }}

parameters.query:
WITH doc AS (
  INSERT INTO kb_documents (source, title, content_sha256, chunk_count, updated_at)
  VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, now())
  ON CONFLICT (source) DO UPDATE
    SET title = EXCLUDED.title, content_sha256 = EXCLUDED.content_sha256,
        chunk_count = EXCLUDED.chunk_count, updated_at = now()
  RETURNING id
), removed AS (
  DELETE FROM kb_chunks WHERE document_id = (SELECT id FROM doc) RETURNING 1
), added AS (
  INSERT INTO kb_chunks (document_id, chunk_index, heading, content, embedding)
  SELECT doc.id, x.chunk_index, x.heading, x.content, x.embedding::vector
  FROM doc, jsonb_to_recordset($5::jsonb) AS x(chunk_index int, heading text, content text, embedding text)
  RETURNING 1
)
SELECT (SELECT id FROM doc) AS document_id,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM removed) AS chunks_removed,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM added) AS chunks_added;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: Number($json.chunks_removed) > 0 ? 'updated' : 'indexed', source: $('Validate & Chunk').first().json.doc.source, document_id: Number($json.document_id), chunks: Number($json.chunks_added), embedding_tokens: $('Prepare Rows').first().json.tokens }) }}
